About The Role
 We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of large-scale digital solutions. In this role, you will shape frontend architecture, build modern and accessible user experiences, and deliver secure, high-performance web applications for our Client, a European public sector organization.
 Responsibilities
Design and deliver modern, scalable, and maintainable frontend applications
Build reusable UI components and contribute to frontend architecture decisions
Transform UX/UI concepts into responsive and accessible user experiences
Implement complex client-side functionality, state management, and integrations
Integrate authentication and authorization using industry-standard protocols
Optimize applications for performance, security, and cross-browser compatibility
Develop automated tests and ensure high code quality standards
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and frontend deployment processes
Create and maintain technical documentation and best practices
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an agile environment
 Requirements
Master's degree (or equivalent qualification) with 10-15+ years of professional IT experience or bachelor’s with 12 -17 years.
Experience in UI development, including HTML and CSS
Hands-on experience with JavaScript
Experience with Angular (or similar frontend frameworks)
Experience with TypeScript and Bootstrap
Strong expertise in Angular (v14+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SASS, and ES6+
Experience working with XML and JSON
Experience using Git and Jira; familiarity with CI/CD tools
Upper-intermediate English (B2+) or higher.
 SoftServe is an equal opportunity employer.
